facts.text: The St. Regis Rome was introduced to society in 1894 and is set in a historic palazzo.
facts.excerpt: Introduced to society in 1894, the architecturally iconic St. Regis Rome is a historic Rome hotel set in one of the city’s most impressive palazzos

facts.text: The St. Regis Rome was the first St. Regis in Europe.
facts.excerpt: The pioneer St. Regis in Europe

facts.text: The Ritz Ballroom was introduced in 1894 as the first public ballroom in Rome.
facts.excerpt: the Ritz Ballroom was introduced in 1894 as the very first public ballroom in Rome

facts.text: The Ritz Ballroom was designed by Roman architect Giulio Podesti and decorated with frescoes by Mario Spinetti.
facts.excerpt: Designed by the Roman architect Giulio Podesti and richly decorated with frescoes by Mario Spinetti

facts.text: Mario Spinetti's frescoes in the Ritz Ballroom are protected by the Belle Arti.
facts.excerpt: Mario Spinetti’s frescoes in the Ritz ballroom are a shining example of Roman Pre-Raphaelite heritage, so much so that they are protected by the Belle Arti

facts.text: The Ritz Ballroom underwent a six-month restoration led by a team of artisans.
facts.excerpt: the Ritz Ballroom has undergone a six-month meticulous restoration led by a team of accomplished artisans

facts.text: The lobby has a dove-grey entrance foyer and a 5-metre hand-blown glass chandelier.
facts.excerpt: a dove-grey entrance foyer and a 5-metre hand-blown glass chandelier

facts.text: The lobby is a Belle-Epoque-inspired indoor piazza that pays homage to the winter garden of Cesar Ritz's original hotel.
facts.excerpt: a luminous Belle-Époque-inspired indoor piazza that pays eloquent homage to the winter garden of César Ritz’s original hotel

facts.text: Interior design firm Pierre-Yves Rochon oversaw the hotel's makeover for Marriott.
facts.excerpt: Marriott employed interior design firm Pierre-Yves Rochon to oversee its makeover.

facts.text: The hotel unveiled a full restoration in November 2018.
facts.excerpt: On the occasion of the unveiling of a meticulous full restoration of The St. Regis Rome

facts.text: The palazzo has a handcrafted stucco-adorned staircase and a historic lift.
facts.excerpt: handcrafted stucco-adorned staircase, the historic lift

facts.text: Guestrooms and suites are styled with Rubelli fabrics, handmade glass and collectable curios.
facts.excerpt: the guestrooms and suites are styled with luxurious Rubelli fabrics, handmade glass and collectable curios

facts.text: Rooms and suites are high-ceilinged and light-filled.
facts.excerpt: High-ceilinged and light-filled, the guestrooms and suites

facts.text: Bathrooms have Marquina black marble tubs and Acqua di Parma toiletries.
facts.excerpt: Bathrooms are big, with Marquina black marble tubs and Acqua di Parma toiletries.

facts.text: In the Royal Suite, an entry hall leads to a living room with a grand piano.
facts.excerpt: An entry hall leads to a beautiful living room with a grand piano.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite is on the palazzo's first level, considered the noble floor.
facts.excerpt: is ideally placed on the palazzo's first level, considered the ‘noble' floor

facts.text: The suites feature original elements such as Murano glass chandeliers.
facts.excerpt: Original elements such as Murano glass chandeliers

facts.text: Small balconies or terraces are limited to specific suites.
facts.excerpt: Only specific Suites have small balconies or terraces.

facts.text: Lumen is the hotel's all-day Italian restaurant, serving breakfast, lunch, aperitif and dinner.
facts.excerpt: We offer culinary delights for breakfast, lunch, aperitif and dinner at our all-day dining Italian restaurant in Rome.

facts.text: At Lumen, many Italian classics are served from the trolley or finished tableside.
facts.excerpt: a menu of Italian classics, many served from the trolley or finished—quite spectacularly—tableside

facts.text: Every evening at 7pm a champagne sabering ritual takes place at Lumen.
facts.excerpt: Every evening at 7pm the Sabering moment announces a real transformation with rhythmic video projections

facts.excerpt: a unique and distinctive Mediterranean version made with all-Italian spices and flavors: the Red Admiral

facts.text: Dammann Freres is the exclusive tea partner for afternoon tea at The St. Regis Rome.
facts.excerpt: Dammann Frères has been selected as exclusive partner at The St. Regis Rome

facts.excerpt: Every Tuesday and Thursday evening, LUMEN invites Roman citizens and international guests to discover The LUMEN Society

facts.text: The LUMEN Signature Glass Collection is designed by contemporary artists and curated by Le Dictateur.

facts.text: An Akira Back Japanese restaurant is announced as coming soon.

facts.text: The hotel offers a virtual reality journey about the Baths of Diocletian, created by IF Experience.
